description.en: Create, start, pause, resize and delete your cmux Cloud machines, take and restore snapshots, and see your plan and usage. cmux keeps your sign-in; this app never sees it.
description.ja: cmux Cloud のマシンを作成、起動、一時停止、サイズ変更、削除し、スナップショットを作成、復元して、プランと使用量を確認します。サインイン情報は cmux が保持し、このアプリは参照しません。

scopes.op:cmux.credential.relay: Send each Cloud request to cmux, which adds your sign-in and calls the cmux Cloud API. The server never receives the sign-in token.

scopes.cloud:read: See your Cloud machines, their status and stats, snapshots, plan and usage.
scopes.cloud:write: Create, start, pause, resize and delete Cloud machines and snapshots, and forward their ports to this Mac, when you or an allowed agent asks. Deletes always need you.
scopes.fs:write: Write, make and copy files on your Cloud machines, and copy files from them to this Mac. Removing a file always needs you.
